label.text: Local nodes paired with this node. A local node pairs in its own System, Edge Node, with a pairing code made here.

default-field.title: Megabytes
default-field.tooltip: The most the items waiting for this node may take; past it the oldest fail. Empty for the conf's queue-max-megabytes, which holds for each pairing alone

container-dialog.title: A new node taking a pairing over

label.text: With none of a pairing's members linked, a node with its key and a new instance id, such as a standby, takes the pairing over. It is admitted and the administrators are told, or it waits for your approval on this page.

After a standby is restored from a backup, its database lacks what was delivered since. Items delivered are kept for the queue's retention period (queue-retention-days of the edge conf, 14 days in the example confs); this sends a pairing's items delivered since the time again. An item the local node has applied does nothing the second time.

default-field.title: Delivered since
default-field.tooltip: The time of the backup the local node was restored from, or a little before

submit.confirmation: Send this pairing's items delivered since then again?

default-field.title: This node's link key fingerprint
default-field.tooltip: The SHA-256 of this node's link key. A local node shows it in its Pair step before it pairs: check that the two match

label.text: Enter it on the local node now, with this node's address. It pairs one node, once, until ${newCodeExpire}. It is shown only this once; make another if you lose it.

default-field.title: Members
default-field.tooltip: Its members linked now: every member of a local cluster links

default-field.title: Key

default-field.title: Queue
default-field.tooltip: Items waiting for the node, sent in order when its link is up; failed ones are kept

default-field.title: Queue cap

default-field.title: A new node
default-field.tooltip: What happens to a node with a new instance id that takes the pairing over while none of its members is linked, such as a standby (New nodes sets it)

link.confirmation: Revoke ${pairedNodeId}? Its link closes, and it can link again only by pairing with a new code.

label.text: No local node is paired yet. Make a pairing code, then pair on the local node.

A node with a new instance id took these pairings over while none of their members was linked, such as a standby started when the first machine died. The node it displaced is refused, so the two never trade the link back and forth with two copies of the data. Let it link again only once it runs on the same data, as a member of the same cluster.

link.confirmation: Let ${fromText} link to ${pairedNodeId} again? Do this only once it runs on the same data as ${toId}.

label.text: Every member of a local node's cluster links on its own. A member joins when a linked member's cluster lists it as live; anything else with the key is refused while one is linked. Drain a member before stopping it: it finishes what it has and gets no new work.

default-field.title: State
default-field.tooltip: What the member says on its link: starting, live, draining or stopping. Only a live member gets new work

default-field.title: In flight
default-field.tooltip: Requests, calls and tunnel opens sent to it and not answered yet; Balancing has more

default-field.title: Heartbeat
default-field.tooltip: The age of its heartbeat in its cluster's list, as its linked members last sent it

link.confirmation: Drain ${instanceId}? It finishes what it has and gets no new work until you resume it; the other members take it.
${instanceId} is the only live member of ${pairedNodeId}. Draining it takes ${pairedNodeId}'s names offline here and holds its queue delivery, until you resume it. Drain it?
Let ${instanceId} take ${pairedNodeId} over? It gets every name of the pairing at its next link.
Forget the key pinned for ${instanceId}? Its next link is a new node's: admitted only when a linked member's cluster lists it, or with none linked as a takeover, with its notice or held for approval.

label.text: No member has linked since this node started. The members are kept in memory and come back with the first link.
Records each local node copies here, read-only, to answer from while it is away.

default-field.tooltip: The local node's full send these records follow
